notes: The Fill Can paints the bricks of the colour it hits, as v20 found them, with the colour or FX can last picked, and stays in hand when a can is picked. /fillcan takes it out. A player it hits takes the colour for a moment, or a random face with an FX can. A vehicle it hits takes the colour (through its spawn brick when the brick recolours it) and its riders take it for a moment, or a random colour with an FX can. Reaching the limit shows the plant-limit error.
